name: o52956

parameter.description: The place parameter to use for selecting dates.

events.description: Which events to display in the calendar.

resource.description: The name of the events resource to pull events from.

types.description: The types of events that should be listed (all other events will be ignored)

resource.description: The name of the resource to subscribe to for search queries.

fields.description: The list of JSON pointers (or paths) pointing to object members to match.

match.description: A mapping from regular expressions to field lists. The last matching group will be searched in the corresponding object members.

additionalProperties.description: The list of JSON pointers similar to the 'fields' list.

resource.description: The name of the resource to publish details with.

action.description: Which action to trigger when details shall be displayed.

navigation.description: Provide a resource representing navigation targets.

description:
The dashboard uses the query parameter **date** to pick the day to display. Event data is pulled from the **events** resource, and only items classified as **meeting** or **holiday** are shown.

User‑initiated searches are routed to the **search_queries** topic. The search engine looks at the fields **/title**, **/description**, and the nested path **metadata/tags**. When the query matches the regular expression **^meeting.*$**, the system examines the **/title** field; if it matches **^holiday$**, it checks the **/category** field. Detailed information about an item is published on the **event_details** resource and displayed by triggering the **show_details** action. Navigation targets are provided via the **nav_targets** resource, with the view advancing in **weeks** intervals.
